mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.student_id, t.type, t.head, t.content, t.updated_date_time, s.name, f.file_url AS avatar FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.type ORDER BY a.updated_date_time DESC, a.id DESC ) AS row_num FROM article a) t LEFT JOIN it_student s ON s.student_id = t.student_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_file f ON f.id = s.avatar_id AND f.deleted = 0 WHERE t.row_num <= #{size} ORDER BY t.type ASC, t.updated_date_time DESC, t.id DESC
